summary: Audited 136 items. Coverage of European/American baked goods is strong (bagel + 6 variants, croissant, brioche, ciabatta, focaccia, sourdough, English muffin, crumpet, babka, scone, biscuit, cake/pie/muffin/waffle/pancake families, dumpling wrappers). The biggest defect is a systematic dietary-tag bug: ~46 wheat-flour items carry a 'Gluten-Free' tag that directly contradicts their sibling items' allergens:['gluten'] (croissant, scone, pancake, waffle, babka, crumpet, pita, lavash, roti, chapati, tandoori, flatbread, texas-toast, all pie variants, etc.). A second class of well-formedness bugs: meat/dairy products tagged Vegan/Vegetarian (shepherd's pie = meat tagged Vegan+Vegetarian; cheesecake & asiago-bagel tagged Vegan+Dairy-Free; chicken-pot/ham-and-cheese carry Gluten-Free). Structurally, the whole 'cornbread' sub-tree is mis-modeled as stuffing: the id 'cornbread' is named 'cornbread stuffing' and parented to 'stuffing', so a user searching 'cornbread' (an alias on it) lands on a stuffing product, and a standalone cornbread loaf is genuinely absent. Global gaps are significant for a 'liberal + global' bar: no injera, arepa, bao, challah (exists only as a bread facet), cornbread-the-bread, soft pretzel, dinner roll, croutons, ciabatta/baguette are present but no puff/filo/shortcrust as distinct pastry doughs (only generic 'pastry dough' + 'phyllo pie shell'), no msemen/laffa/barbari/roti-canai/paratha, no rusk/melba/grissini, no pretzel (only 'pretzel bun'), no naan variants beyond plain. Proposing 28 new items, the systematic Gluten-Free removal, vegan/vegetarian corrections, and a cornbread re-model.
issues: SYSTEMATIC: ~46 wheat-flour items are tagged 'Gluten-Free' while their sibling/parent items carry allergens:['gluten']. Affected: almond-croissant, american-waffle, apple-pie, babka, banana-pancake, belgian-waffle, brussels, chapati, cheese-babka, cherry-pie, chicken-pot, cinnamon-babka, cranberry-scone, crescent-roll, croissant, crumpet, dough, dough-sourdough, flatbread, ham-and-cheese, key-lime, lavash, lemon-meringue, liege, mini-croissant, nut-babka, nutella, pancake, pecan-pie, phyllo, pie, pie-shell, pita, pizza, poppy-seed-babka, protein, raisin-scone, roti, scone, shepherd-s, sweet-potato-pie, tandoori, taco-shell, texas-toast, waffle, wrapper. All are conventionally wheat-flour based; the 'Gluten-Free' tag is wrong and should be removed (see cleanups). Note 'gluten-free-bread' correctly keeps it.
shepherd-s ('shepherd's pie', a ground-meat dish) is tagged Vegetarian AND Vegan — both wrong; it is also parented to 'pie' (dessert/pastry family) which is a category-fit question but acceptable.
cheesecake is tagged Vegan + Dairy-Free despite being a cheese/dairy dessert; should be neither Vegan nor Dairy-Free (allergens should include 'dairy').
asiago-bagel is tagged Vegan + Dairy-Free despite asiago being cheese; should drop Vegan and Dairy-Free, add allergens:['dairy'].

Mislabeled cornbread sub-tree: 'cornbread' is named 'cornbread stuffing' and parentIds=['stuffing'], yet carries aliases 'cornbread'/'corn bread'/'cornbreads'. classic-cornbread/honey-cornbread/jalapeno-cornbread/skillet are all '<x> cornbread stuffing' under it. There is NO standalone cornbread loaf/bread item. This conflates a quick-bread with a Thanksgiving stuffing mix and makes 'cornbread' searches misleading.

Bare/ambiguous ids that are hard to read in isolation: 'drop' (drop biscuit), 'everything' (everything bagel), 'brussels' (brussels waffle), 'liege' (liege waffle), 'polish' (polish dumpling wrapper), 'russian' (russian dumpling wrapper), 'tibetan' (tibetan dumpling wrapper), 'japanese' (japanese dumpling wrapper), 'korean'/'chinese'/'graham'/'phyllo'/'sponge'/'pound'/'cheesy'/'shepherd-s'. These are not bugs per se but reduce legibility; ids could be namespaced (e.g. 'drop-biscuit').
pretzel exists only as 'pretzel bun' (parent 'bun'). There is no standalone soft pretzel (a snack/bakery staple) — searching 'pretzel' returns a hamburger-style bun.

challah exists only as a 'variant' facet on bread/baguette/bread-sourdough, not as its own item, despite being a distinct named bread the spec calls out. Same is effectively true for rye/pumpernickel/multigrain/potato/oat (facets only) — acceptable as facets, but challah is prominent enough to merit its own item.

taco-shell is tagged Vegan + Gluten-Free + has a 'flour' form facet. The corn (default) shell is GF; the flour-form shell is not. Tag reflects the corn default which is defensible, but the 'flour' form makes the blanket Gluten-Free tag imprecise.
phyllo ('phyllo pie shell') is tagged Gluten-Free though filo/phyllo is wheat-flour dough — part of the systematic GF bug.

ham-and-cheese (a filled croissant/pastry) is parented to 'croissant', tagged Gluten-Free, and is neither Vegetarian nor Vegan (correctly omitted) but the GF tag is wrong; allergens should be ['gluten','dairy'].
redundancies: cornbread is named 'cornbread stuffing' and parented under stuffing; it overlaps the generic 'stuffing' item AND blocks a real cornbread bread. Recommend re-modeling (see cleanups) rather than deleting.

Near-identical: 'wrapper' (generic) and 'dumpling' (dumpling wrapper) carry the same variant facet set (egg roll/gyoza/potsticker/rice paper/siu mai/spring roll/wonton) and 'dumpling' is parented to 'wrapper'. The generic 'wrapper' adds little once 'dumpling wrapper' exists; consider whether both top-level entries are needed.
Sourdough English muffin is a thin variant differing only by leavening; could be a facet/variant of english-muffin rather than a sibling item (consistent with how challah/rye are facets of bread).

Sourdough garlic bread differs from garlic-bread only by base loaf; candidate for facet rather than separate item (and note storage differs: garlic-bread is Frozen, garlic-bread-sourdough is Pantry — inconsistent).
'classic cornbread stuffing' vs 'cornbread stuffing' are effectively the same product; classic-cornbread adds no distinguishing attribute over the base.

newItems.name: injera
newItems.notes: Ethiopian/Eritrean spongy sourdough flatbread made from teff; naturally gluten-free when 100% teff but commonly cut with wheat — leaving gluten unflagged to match house default for wheat-blend versions.

newItems.name: arepa
newItems.notes: Venezuelan/Colombian griddled cornmeal cake (masarepa). Naturally gluten-free; storage grounded in keepandstore/quearepas (fridge 3-5d unfilled, freezer 2-3mo).

newItems.name: bao bun
newItems.notes: Chinese steamed wheat bun (plain dough). Storage from KimEcopak/Pantry&Larder (fridge 4-5d plain, freezer 2-3mo); sold mostly frozen.

newItems.name: challah
newItems.notes: Jewish braided egg bread. Contains egg so NOT vegan/dairy-free-only; allergens egg+gluten. Currently only a facet of bread; promoting to its own item.

newItems.name: cornbread
newItems.notes: American quick bread (cornmeal). Distinct from the mislabeled 'cornbread stuffing' tree. Typically contains egg/dairy so not vegan by default.

newItems.name: soft pretzel
newItems.notes: German lye-bath wheat pretzel (snack/bakery). Distinct from existing 'pretzel bun'.

newItems.name: puff pastry
newItems.notes: Laminated wheat pastry dough; sold frozen in sheets. Storage from cookist/stilltasty (fridge ~3d thawed, freezer up to 10-12mo). Many supermarket brands are coincidentally vegan (vegetable fat).

newItems.name: filo pastry
newItems.notes: Paper-thin wheat dough for baklava/spanakopita. Distinct from the existing 'phyllo pie shell' (a pre-formed shell); this is the raw dough sheet.

newItems.name: shortcrust pastry
newItems.notes: Butter-and-flour pastry for pies/tarts. Storage from freezeit/silverspoon (fridge ~3d, freezer ~1mo uncooked). Usually contains butter so not vegan/dairy-free by default.

newItems.name: croutons
newItems.notes: Dried/toasted bread cubes; shelf-stable like breadcrumbs. A bread 'form' facet exists but no standalone item.

newItems.name: ladi pav
newItems.notes: Indian soft slider-style bun (pav bhaji, vada pav). Pan-attached square rolls.

newItems.name: dinner roll
newItems.notes: Soft small dinner/table rolls; very common staple, currently only reachable via 'bun'.

newItems.name: ciabatta roll
newItems.notes: Individual ciabatta roll for sandwiches/panini; distinct serving form from the ciabatta loaf.

newItems.name: kaiser roll
newItems.notes: Crusty round sandwich roll (Austrian/German). Common deli staple.

newItems.name: paratha
newItems.notes: South/Southeast Asian layered/flaky flatbread; commonly sold frozen. (Plain version vegan; ghee versions are not — defaulting to vegan oil version.)

newItems.name: barbari
newItems.notes: Iranian thick oval flatbread topped with sesame/nigella.

newItems.name: laffa
newItems.notes: Large Middle Eastern/Iraqi soft flatbread for wraps and shawarma.

newItems.name: msemen
newItems.notes: Moroccan layered square semolina flatbread/pancake.

newItems.name: bolillo
newItems.notes: Mexican crusty white roll (tortas, molletes).

newItems.name: pao de queijo
newItems.notes: Brazilian tapioca-flour cheese bread; naturally GLUTEN-FREE (cassava starch) but contains cheese/egg so not vegan/dairy-free.

newItems.name: rye bread
newItems.notes: Rye/pumpernickel loaf. Currently only a 'variant' facet on bread; promoting given its prominence (denser, longer-keeping than white).

newItems.name: sandwich bread
newItems.notes: Standard sliced sandwich/toast loaf — arguably the single most common bread; the base 'bread' item exists but a named sandwich-loaf entry improves search hits.

newItems.name: grissini
newItems.notes: Dry Italian breadsticks; shelf-stable like crackers.

newItems.name: melba toast
newItems.notes: Twice-baked dry toast/rusk; shelf-stable.

newItems.name: wonton wrapper
newItems.notes: Square egg-noodle wrapper; currently only a facet on dumpling/wrapper. Contains egg (not vegan). Promoting given how often it is shopped by name.

newItems.name: spring roll wrapper
newItems.notes: Rice-paper / spring-roll wrapper; rice-paper version is gluten-free and shelf-stable (dried). Currently only a facet.

newItems.name: tortilla wrap
newItems.notes: Large flour wrap (often flavored) for wraps/burritos; distinct shopper term from 'tortilla', currently only an alias.
